5089.title: [skia-sync] Record the Chrome M151 branch retirement
5089.body:
[skia-sync] Record the Chrome M151 branch retirement (#5089)

Requires: https://github.com/mono/skia/pull/365
Changes: https://github.com/google/skia/compare/7ad44b72c93c242f96f2563edb566439fe816c0a...b91d74bf28bcc5bc94e0f7b810b4f023f74537ab
Context: https://github.com/mono/SkiaSharp/pull/5097

Bump externals/skia to the merged release/4.151.x tip
ad2b1b49da724dc996c773043075eed32690aa6c and record the final upstream
Chrome M151 commit in cgmanifest.

The upstream commit retires Skia CQ metadata after Chrome M151 became
unsupported. The mono/skia release branch had already removed the same file,
so the old and new native revisions have the identical tree
3d75c138755c7cc8143349bd32adcb649e1e43b8. This update changes provenance
and preserves upstream merge ancestry without changing shipped product bits.

Keep the Skia milestone, native ABI, assembly and package versions, C API,
managed wrappers, generated bindings, and dependency pins unchanged. The
review retained all 100 interop patches and all 17 audited dependency entries.

The merged-source Linux x64 build and unfiltered managed test solution passed.
The remaining iOS macOS check failure was an accepted agent-loss infrastructure
failure and is unrelated to this tree-identical update.

Co-authored-by: Matthew Leibowitz <mattleibow@live.com>
Co-authored-by: Copilot <223556219+Copilot@users.noreply.github.com>
